verses.1: The songs of praise are for all those who fear the Lord and walk in His ways.
verses.2: Your strength will increase, for you will eat your own flesh. This will be good for you.
verses.3: Your wife is like a fruitful vine in your home. Your children are like olives surrounding your table.
verses.4: See, thus will the righteous person be blessed, who fears the LORD.
verses.5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, and may He see Jerusalem in good health throughout all your days.
verses.6: And see, children, that your peace belongs to Israel.
